notes: needs_ruling: «قال أبو إسحاق إبراهيم بن محمد بن سفيان» sits inside the first isnad after نعيم بن حماد; whether it is a link (a name introduced by «قال») or Muslim's aside is not settled by the text, so it is not written
the first group therefore ends at نعيم بن حماد; the second isnad («وحدثنا محمد بن يحيى») is a second group, not a variant
the saying («كان عمرو بن عبيد يكذب») is Yunus's words
